levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث

notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch runs through «أبي» and «جدي» (relations, rule 7); the second through Hajjaj and Hujayn; both meet at «الليث», the first name the text writes after the last «ح», so Layth is the shared tail
The text does not say who «جدي» is, so the identity of the grandfather is not decided here
